chars.SON: SON: a young man of about 20 wearing a bright mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.DAD: DAD: a heavier man in his fifties with a thick grey moustache drawn on the white head, wearing a dark green traditional Moroccan djellaba with the hood down and brown leather babouche slippers.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman of about 20 with a long dark ponytail drawn on the white head, wearing a light pink puffer jacket, blue jeans and white sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening engagement visit in a Moroccan family living room in a small Moroccan town: long Moroccan sedari sofas with patterned cushions, a silver tea tray with a teapot, a big tray of Moroccan cookies and a bouquet of flowers on the low table. DAD sits proudly on the sofa among blurred guests; SON leans down and whispers in DAD's ear with a sneaky nervous look, holding his phone behind his back.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room at the engagement visit. DAD waves his hand dismissively telling SON to go, while SON already stands up and heads toward the door with a relieved sneaky grin, phone in hand.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night street of a small Moroccan town with white and ochre houses, closed shop shutters and a street lamp. SON rushes away quickly, looking back over his shoulder to check nobody follows him, excited and nervous.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night. SON sits in the back of a red Moroccan petit taxi driving through a small Moroccan town street, typing on his phone with an excited impatient face; lit shop fronts pass by outside the window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, front door of a modest Moroccan family house in a quiet alley. SON opens the door and secretly lets GIRL in, putting a finger to his mouth for silence and looking left and right down the alley; GIRL slips inside giggling nervously.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the simple Moroccan family living room at night, sedari sofas, a TV and a wall clock. SON and GIRL sit side by side on the sofa, fully dressed, talking and laughing happily together, two glasses of soda and a bag of chips on the low table. Cosy, innocent mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room, very late at night, dim light from the TV. SON and GIRL have fallen asleep sitting on the sofa, fully dressed, heads tilted back, mouths open; the wall clock shows very late.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Split view of the same Moroccan house at night: on the left outside the front door DAD in his green djellaba knocks hard on the door with an angry face; on the right inside, SON jumps up from the sofa wide awake in total panic, eyes huge, hands on his head.
